title: The Lost Surveyor
rumor: The Lost Surveyor. A surveyor vanished while mapping mineral deposits beyond the known claims. Months later, his field notebook was discovered beside a stream, containing careful drawings of a valley that no local guide recognizes. The final pages depict a strange tower standing among trees whose leaves appear to be made of stone.
first_lead: The notebook passed through several hands before reaching a private collection in Blackvein.
